d.seg: WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat, all of them are deleted
d.tr: WhatsApp, Instagram, Snapchat, all of them are deleted
d.ctx: The user greeted and then immediately listed several external apps stating they are deleted. The other person said hello in response.
d.j: It matches the weaker case as a negation/denial of using external apps, making it a non-violation.
